Commentary.Commentary: So, Pakistan have become the no. 1 side in the T20Is. They suffered a 5-0 whitewash in ODIs, they were 1-0 down in the T20I series and have comeback in an emphatic manner to seal the series. They can now concentrate on the domestic T20 league while the Kiwis will now play a tri-series including Australia and England. Before we leave, you can catch some action from the on-going Australia vs England, 5th ODI where the Aussies are cruising along. Until then, goodbye and cheers!

Winning captain, Sarfraz Ahmed thanks the Almighty. Credits his bowlers and states it's because of them they have won the series. Is proud of the boys for being 0-6 down and then coming back and winning the series. Feels it was an all-round display from them today and is happy to be on the right side of the result. Opines if you have wickets in hand, the lower-order can capitalize and that is what they did today. Signs off by thanking the crowd for their support.

Kiwi skipper, Kane Williamson starts by crediting Pakistan. Admits they weren't good with the ball nor with the bat and rues their fielding big time. Feels the score wasn't that big to chase down but praises opposition's bowling to not let them off the hook. Lauds Taylor and Bruce for revoking the hopes by some massive hits but once again emphasizes on the fielding as it plays an important role. Ends by saying they need to sort their issues as they can't afford to blip with the tri-series coming up against Australia and England.

Man of the Series, Mohammad Amir is happy with his performance. Is disappointed to lose the ODI series but is happy to come back and win the T20Is. Reckons, variations play a very important role in T20s and he just keeps working on it. Ends by saying they are happy to become the no. 1 team.
Man of the Match, Shadab Khan thanks the Almighty and then his parents for pushing and praying for him. Says he loves playing there and that he carried his form from the Australian domestic T20.

Chasing 182 was never going to be easy and New Zealand needed a flier to be in the chase. The Pakistan bowlers were right on the money to not let the Kiwi openers settle in. Martin Guptill alone batted is way to a half century but the 13th over from Shadab Khan dented all the hopes that the hosts had. However, Ross Taylor then walked in and swung around to revoke the hopes but a good review from Amir ended his stay. Amir and Raees then displayed classic death bowling and ran away with the game.

What a win for Pakistan! Thoroughly deserving! They have once again outclassed and outplayed the Kiwis to come out on top. Wonder where was this intensity when the tour began? Anyway, it's past now and today is something they would cherish as they end the tour on the right note. Summary - they won the toss and opted to bat. Once again their batting clicked (something that was lacking throughout) as a unit as they amassed a huge score on the board, courtesy some shoddy fielding from the home side.
PAKISTAN SEAL THE T20I SERIES! They beat the Kiwis by 18 runs! Ashraf bowls a yorker on the stumps, Santner jams it out back down the track and it hits the stumps at the other end.
FOUR! Edged! Slower delivery outside off, Santner goes hard at it. Gets a thick edge and it flies over short third man for a boundary.
SIX! What a hit! Makes room to a length ball and slams it a long way over long on for a maximum. Sarfraz is angry on his bowler. He wants him to hit the yorker length but it's nowhere near to it.
Yorker length, perfect from Faheem. Santner fails to put bat on ball.
Dropped! Back of a length delivery on middle, Santner hits it hard towards long on. Fakhar Zaman comes across to his left, puts in a dive but fails to hold on to the catch. Two taken.
Makes room and pulls it towards wide long on for a couple of runs.

Caught but it's a no ball! A waist height full toss, Blundell swings at it. Rumman Raees at deep square leg takes it and then realizes it is a no ball. They take one. Free Hit! Do New Zealand still have a chance?
35 required off the final over. NZ need 6 maximums...
Beaten again! Rolls his finger over the ball, Santner gets deceived by it. Swings and gets beaten. The Pakistan skipper is really pumped up as if this was the last over of the game.
Slower delivery, cleverly bowled, pushed towards cover for a single.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Wide! Gets across to play the paddle but misses it. The umpire, strangely calls it a wide and Amir isn't amused.
Wide yorker, Blundell makes room to carve this one but gets beaten.
Shorter in length, MS pulls it down to long on for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller in length and just outside off, Santner makes room and lofts it cleanly down the ground for a one-bounce boundary.
Flicked away to the leg side for a single.
Wide!  Unusual bounce. Too high to worry the batsman! The umpire has signalled a wide.
FOUR! Whipped! Clears the front leg and whips this inswinging yorker over mid-wicket for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Nothing on Snicko! Very full, almost a yorker, Santner tries to dig it out but seems to have missed it. The ball goes to the keeper who starts to appeal and is the only one doing so. He has a chat with his bowler and then decides to use the review. Replays roll in, there was no spike as the ball passed the bat.
Another review for a caught behind. Raees didn't look that confident but his skipper feels that he heard something.
Mitchell Santner is in next.

OUT! Bowled off a full toss! Rumman Raees stands and admires what just happened before his mates come barging towards him. On the stumps, Tom Bruce comes down the track and swings wildly at it. Misses and hears the death rattle. Pakistan are running away with this one.
FOUR! Cheeky and effective! Gets across a touch to a length ball and paddles it over the head of the keeper for a much-needed boundary. The equation comes down under fifty now.
Deadly yorker! Right into the blockhole, Tom Bruce could do nothing. He digs it out back to Raees who leaps and collects it with his left hand in the followthrough.
Chips it in the air over mid-wicket for a single to end the over. What an over, certainly a game-changing one. Just 3 and a big wicket off it. 52 needed from 18 now.
Very full, it's almost a yorker, Bruce makes room to jam it out but fails to put bat on ball.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked down to fine leg for one.
Tom Blundell is the new man in.

OUT! Ross Taylor has edged this! Amir was confident that there was an edge and he convinced his skipper to opt for one. A vital breakthrough for Pakistan. Is that the game? Ross shuffles inside the crease but Amir keeps his calm and fires it on leg. Taylor looks to jam it out but it goes through his legs to the keeper. But Ahmed didn't hear anything. He collects the ball and then underarms the throw at the striker's end but misses and it hits the other end instead. Amir is busy appealing but poor bowler. The umpire doesn't pay any heed and plus his captain is angry on him as to why isn't he backing up. He then says he has heard a noise and asks to take the DRS. Snicko rolls in and it spots an edge as the ball passes the bat. Taylor is shocked but has to walk back.
Out or not out? Pakistan have taken the review against Taylor for caught behind.
Good ball! Fires in a yorker, Taylor jams it out back to Amir.
Attacks the stumps, keeps it full and wide, Tom Bruce makes room and jams it out towards cover for one.
Mohammad Amir is back into the attack. 55 needed from 24 balls.

A full toss, it dips in, Taylor is early into the swing. Mistimes it horribly towards long on and luckily for him it lands safely before the fielder there. Two added to the total. 17 off this, a huge one.
Very full on leg, flicked through backward square leg for a single. Last ball, 15 already from the over.
SIX! Murders the slower delivery does Bruce! He reds it, makes room and towers it high and handsome over the deep mid-wicket fence.
Misses out on a full toss, Taylor could only heave it off the inner half to mid-wicket. A single.

SIX! What was that? Just a gentle flick and it goes a long way! Raees hurls a length delivery on middle and off, Ross comes down the track and drops kicks it off the pads. Gets a maximum to his name, his third in the innings.
Bruce makes room, Raees follows him with a full ball, jammed down to long on for a single.
Rumman Raees is back on. NZ need 72 from the last 5 overs.

In the air... safe! Good length delivery, outside off, Taylor swings hard at it. The ball goes off the top edge towards third man where Raees comes sprinting in, puts in a dive forward but the ball just dips in front of him. He collects it on the bounce and by the time he returns a throw, they take a brace.
Backs away and slashes it through cover for a single.
On a length and just outside off, Taylor ekes out a thick edge down to third man for a single.

SIX! Second biggie of the over! Meaty blow! Taylor was expecting this length. He gets across a long away and smacks it with a powerful slog. Sends soaring over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Beaten! On a length and angles it in on middle and leg, Ross swings at it but misses it.
SIX! Boom goes Ross! Gets a length ball, shimmies down a touch and pummels it over the deep mid-wicket fence for half a dozen.
Faheem Ashraf is brought back into the attack.
FOUR! Easily done! Short ball, angling down leg, Bruce just helps it on its away down to fine leg to end the over with a boundary. Last two overs, Pakistan have picked up three wickets for 10 runs.
Length delivery on middle, defended off the back foot.
Fuller in length and on the stumps, eased down to long on for one.
Ross Taylor is next. New Zealand need 93 in 39 balls. How good it would have been for them had the figures been reversed?

OUT! Bowled 'em! The Kiwis are falling like a pack of cards. Yamin comes in from over the wicket and bowls it with a cross-seam. It hits the deck and skids off. Colin de Grandhomme looks to pull it away but the ball sneaks under his bat to hit the off stump.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped in front of point. Shadab scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but the batsman was easily in.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven through cover to get off the mark.
Colin de Grandhomme is the new man in. Also, Aamer Yamin comes back on.

OUT! Shadab gets the big fish! And that too on the last ball of his spell. He has drawn the advantage home probably. Sarfraz Ahmed is all pumped up. He knows the importance of this wicket. Shadab slows it through the air, tosses it up outside off, Guptill gets down on one knee to play the slog sweep but it turns away. The ball goes off the top edge and it's a simple catch to Fakhar Zaman at deep mid-wicket. Martin is fuming as he walks back in disappointment. Superb spell from the leggie. His figures are 4-0-19-2!
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Quicker again, Guptill goes back to cut but chops it in the same region for one.
Quicker and flatter through the air, chopped in front of point for a single.
Tom Bruce walks in next.

OUT! Stumped! Kitchen departs. This could be a blessing in disguise for the Kiwis as he was putting pressure on Guptill. A loopy leg break, pitched on off. Anaru dances down the track to go big but the ball turns away with good bounce to beat the outside edge. Sarfraz behind the stumps collects and takes the bails off.
Slips in a wide googly, Anaru goes fishing after it and gets beaten.
A bit too straight on the pads, deflected down to fine leg for a brace. 98 needed from 48 balls.
Another dot! Sarfraz Ahmed appreciates this! Short and following the batsman, Martin is cramped for room. Gets beaten on the inside and it goes to the keeper.
Comes forward to a length ball and pushes it back to Ashraf.
FOUR! Using the pace of the bowler! Short ball, a bit wider outside off, Guptill backs away and steers it down to third man for a boundary.
Very full on off, drilled towards long off for just a single.
Fuller ball on the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Faheem Ashraf comes back into the attack.
Flatter through the air, pulled wide of long on for a single. 11 off the over.

Fifty up for Martin Guptill! Goes back to the short ball and punches it square of the wicket on the off side. Yamin in the deep does well to stop it with a slide. They refer it upstairs to see if the fielder made contact with the rope when he had the ball in hand. Nope, he didn't. Just a brace. He holds the key for the Kiwis if they are to win.

FOUR! Edgedddd but that will do! Shadab bowls another googly, Guptill goes hard at it. Gets it off the edge and beats short third man and backward point for a boundary. Moves to 48 with that one. Brings up 2000 T20I runs. A nice milestone to have.
A bit flatter around middle and off, punched down to long on. Wants two and gets them comfortably in the end.
Around middle and leg, worked away towards mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Floats it up outside off, it's the googly, Guptill gets down to sweep but misses as the ball turns away.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, whipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
SIX! SLAP! A short ball on middle, Guptill pulls it miles over mid-wicket!
WIDE. A bouncer on off, Martin sways away.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Landed outside off, Kitchen looks for the pull but misses.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Landed outside off, Martin looks to push it through the off side but misses.
Guptill looks to cut but misses.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers but straight to the fielder.
A short ball now, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Kitchen looks to cut but misses.
A short ball outside off, pulled towards deep mid-wicket. Did not time it well, else it would have been a wicket.
A short ball on middle, Anaru looks to pull but misses and is hit on the box.
A bouncer now, Kitchen ducks.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
A short ball on middle, Guptill pulls it through square leg for a single.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Aamer Yamin is back on.
Landed outside off, perhaps the googly, Martin looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards short third man.
Outside off, left alone.
On middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a run.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, driven towards mid on for a single.
A box of balls comes out. That was some power by Guptill. Meanwhile, Shadab Khan comes on to bowl.
SIX! SLAM! That has gone into orbit! A length ball on middle, Guptill swings it miles over the sightscreen and clears the ground by some distance! 15 from the over, 135 needed from 84 balls!
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Hello, what's cooking in the kitchen? Three balls, two fours! This is even better than the previous one. Short and outside off, Kitchen punches it behind point and the ball races away!
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
FOUR! What a start! Short and outside off, Kitchen cuts it through point for a boundary!
Anaru Kitchen is the new man in.
OUT! Finds the man! A short ball outside off, Williamson comes down the track and slashes hard but cannot clear the man inside the ring at cover-point. Simple catch for Babar Azam.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl now.
Full on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
The batsman works it down the leg side for a couple.
Outside off, Guptill slashes hard but misses.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, pushed towards point for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! That is why Williamson need not play cheeky shots. This guy is there to play the attacking shots. A short ball on middle and leg, Guptill just pulls it way over square leg!
On middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a run.

Not necessary... Williamson gets across his stumps to play a paddle when he does not need to. Raees bowls it on the stumps and luckily for the Kiwis skipper, the ball goes over the stumps. He only needs to bat through... the others can play the cheeky shots.
Outside off, pushed to the off side for a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
SIX! Not in control but maximum result! A short ball on middle, Guptill looks to pull but does so with his eyes closed. The ball flies off the top edge over the backward square leg fence.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED. What was Williamson thinking? First he pushed the ball towards point and said, 'WAIT ON!' Shadab Khan the man there gets across to his right and fumbles a bit. Now Williamson starts to run and Guptill responds. But that is a suicidal call and halfway through, Williamson gives up. Luckily for him, the throw misses the stumps at the bowler's end. Williamson then indicates a thumbs up to his partner and then shrugs off the call with a smile.
On middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Mohammed Amir into the attack now.

A short ball on middle and leg, Kane swivels to pull but misses and is hit on the box. For some reason, Sarfraz Ahmed appeals for LBW. What a comeback from Raees after going for 5 runs on his first two balls. 4 dots in a row.
Punched to cover again.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Williamson just eases it past short fine leg and gets a boundary.
Outside off, punched down the ground for a single.
Rumman Raees to share the new ball with Yamin.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Outside off, Williamson looks to run it down to third man but gets hit on the gloves. Manages to dab it down to point for another single.
On middle and leg, pushed wide of mid on for a quick one.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on for a single.

We are back. Was that even a break? Geez, I could not even complete my coffee. So inhuman, not to even allow the commentators to take a coffee break. But we are professional. Will cover the game and forgo the coffee. Martin Guptill and Kane Williamson are the openers. Aamer Yamin to Guptill first up...
